PLAN "12-Week General Strength Program (Post-L4/L5, No Heavy Spinal Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength while respecting lumbar precautions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation and Motor Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body + Core (Spine-Sparing)":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          single_leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_hamstring_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          db_split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust_machine 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          machine_chest_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown_neutral 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_cable_row_neutral 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          db_incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_supported_db_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          half_kneeling_pallof_hold 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bugs 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          treadmill_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Accessory + Conditioning":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up_low_box 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
